g.text: 1. 24 V INPUT PROTECTION (fuse, reverse-polarity P-FET, TVS)

g.desc: 1. 24 V INPUT PROTECTION (fuse, reverse-polarity P-FET, TVS)

g.text: J5: limit switches (BOM: ME-8108) wired on the NC contact between +24V_FIELD (J5.1) and IN_LIM_x (open = limit reached or wire break -> LOW -> safe); confirm the NC terminal on the real part.

g.desc: J5: limit switches (BOM: ME-8108) wired on the NC contact between +24V_FIELD (J5.1) and IN_LIM_x (open = limit reached or wire break -> LOW -> safe); confirm the NC terminal on the real part.

g.text: IN_BEAM: the BOM through-beam receiver (Delta PS-MT5 series, PNP) drives 24 V onto IN_BEAM when the beam is clear (light-ON) -> compatible with the active-high input; break / loss of supply = LOW = blocked (fail-safe). Confirm light-ON/NO output on the real part.

g.desc: IN_BEAM: the BOM through-beam receiver (Delta PS-MT5 series, PNP) drives 24 V onto IN_BEAM when the beam is clear (light-ON) -> compatible with the active-high input; break / loss of supply = LOW = blocked (fail-safe). Confirm light-ON/NO output on the real part.

g.text: J6: dry contacts closed to +24V_FIELD (J6.3) = OK; no AC-OK / BAT-OK source device is in the BOM (LRS-150/200-24 has no status output): link J6.1 to J6.3 to disable mains-loss sensing in the baseline.

g.desc: J6: dry contacts closed to +24V_FIELD (J6.3) = OK; no AC-OK / BAT-OK source device is in the BOM (LRS-150/200-24 has no status output): link J6.1 to J6.3 to disable mains-loss sensing in the baseline.

g.text: K1 = external DIN contactor Schneider LC1D09BD (24 VDC coil); its contacts switch the +24V line to the IBT-2 module B+ (off this PCB). E-stop (BOM: ProMax 22 mm 2-pole, contacts 1 A DC)

g.desc: K1 = external DIN contactor Schneider LC1D09BD (24 VDC coil); its contacts switch the +24V line to the IBT-2 module B+ (off this PCB). E-stop (BOM: ProMax 22 mm 2-pole, contacts 1 A DC)

g.text: NC contact in series with the coil supply: pressing it de-energises K1 and removes motor power regardless of firmware; ESTOP_OK also forces the IBT-2 R_EN/L_EN and RPWM low via U9/U19.

g.desc: NC contact in series with the coil supply: pressing it de-energises K1 and removes motor power regardless of firmware; ESTOP_OK also forces the IBT-2 R_EN/L_EN and RPWM low via U9/U19.

g.text: The contactor coil current (about 0.2 A at 24 V, assumed, to be confirmed on the datasheet) is carried by J4.1 / the E-stop contact, which is rated 1 A DC.

g.desc: The contactor coil current (about 0.2 A at 24 V, assumed, to be confirmed on the datasheet) is carried by J4.1 / the E-stop contact, which is rated 1 A DC.

g.text: 6. H-BRIDGE: IBT-2 (BTS7960) MODULE HEADER + hardware interlocks (74AHCT1G08 @ 5 V)

g.desc: 6. H-BRIDGE: IBT-2 (BTS7960) MODULE HEADER + hardware interlocks (74AHCT1G08 @ 5 V)

g.text: 9. HUB12 (P10) + WS2812 LEVEL SHIFT (74HCT245 @5 V), BUZZER

g.desc: 9. HUB12 (P10) + WS2812 LEVEL SHIFT (74HCT245 @5 V), BUZZER

g.text: Notes: (a) Symbol MAX481E used for THVD1450DR (identical 8-pin RS485 pinout). (b) TLV62568DBV symbol used for TLV62569DBVR (same pinout).

g.desc: Notes: (a) Symbol MAX481E used for THVD1450DR (identical 8-pin RS485 pinout). (b) TLV62568DBV symbol used for TLV62569DBVR (same pinout).

g.text: (c) 74LS245 symbol used for SN74HCT245PWR and 74LVC1G08 symbol used for the 74AHCT1G08 gates U9/U10/U19 (same pinout).

g.desc: (c) 74LS245 symbol used for SN74HCT245PWR and 74LVC1G08 symbol used for the 74AHCT1G08 gates U9/U10/U19 (same pinout).

g.text: (d) K1 is the external DIN contactor LC1D09BD (24 VDC coil); only its coil terminals reach this PCB. The motor power path (K1 contacts -> IBT-2 module B+/B- -> motor) does NOT pass over this PCB.

g.desc: (d) K1 is the external DIN contactor LC1D09BD (24 VDC coil); only its coil terminals reach this PCB. The motor power path (K1 contacts -> IBT-2 module B+/B- -> motor) does NOT pass over this PCB.

g.text: (e) Values marked * are design targets - verify against datasheets during layout. (f) GPIO3/45/46 (straps) and GPIO35-37 (octal PSRAM on N16R8) left unconnected; module is the BOM part N16R8, the N8 is footprint- and pin-compatible.

g.desc: (e) Values marked * are design targets - verify against datasheets during layout. (f) GPIO3/45/46 (straps) and GPIO35-37 (octal PSRAM on N16R8) left unconnected; module is the BOM part N16R8, the N8 is footprint- and pin-compatible.
